SITUATION NOW
Antifa militants assaulted a professor during a lecture in Belgium over his research into military AI. [5]
Belgium's nitrous oxide use is fueling nightlife, crime, and a waste management crisis. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR BELGIUM
The assault on a professor over military AI research may increase security concerns for academics in Belgium, as the country is linked to 40 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [5][E2]

KEY RISKS
Belgium's 75% net energy import dependency exposes it to supply disruptions. [E3]
